question: Do fresh typed words remain all-or-none over every member of their fixed class under alive2c?
number: 32 complete class checks (16 fresh one-per-class plus 8 class-0 and 8 class-15 supplemental checks); 0 mixed counts
notes: Each allmem count is over all 32768 members and is either 0 or 32768. This strengthens but does not prove class invariance; the representative claim remains open.
